title: Remote
upgrade: Connect through the SSH hosts in this computer’s ~/.ssh/config.

error.payload_missing_local: This copy of PrismNext is missing the remote Host program. Reinstall PrismNext. The server downloads Node, Git, and Tectonic itself; it does not download the Host program.
error.ssh_missing: OpenSSH `ssh` is not on this computer’s PATH. Install it, then connect again.
error.ssh_jump: SSH jump host failed. Check ProxyJump / ProxyCommand in ~/.ssh/config.
error.displaced: Another computer took over this Host. Connect again from this computer if you need it.

agentNotReady: Remote Agent is not connected yet. You can browse files and use the terminal.
missingLocalKey: No API key on this computer for the selected model. Add it in Settings → AI.
hostModelUnconfigured: The remote Host has no API keys. Disconnect and reconnect so this computer can send the keys from Settings → Models. Connection steps must show the Model keys gate as ok.
missingHostApiKey: The remote Host has no API key for {{provider}}. Save that vendor’s key in Settings → Models, then disconnect and reconnect (or save Settings again while connected).
attachmentNotUploaded: Move the attachment into the remote folder, or send the image inline.
attachmentTooLarge: That attachment is larger than 5 MB. Copy it into the remote folder first.
modelKeysNote: The remote Host calls the model vendor directly. Keys are stored on the server as AES-256-GCM ciphertext; the unwrap key stays on this computer.
gatewayNote: The remote Host calls the model vendor directly. Keys are stored on the server as AES-256-GCM ciphertext; the unwrap key stays on this computer.
modulePending: This tool is not available on Remote Agent yet.
noRemoteProjects: No projects on this host yet
nameInvalid: Enter a folder name without slashes.
permissionsSavedOnServer: Allow-always rules for this remote project are stored on the server.
sessionReadOnlyCache: Offline copy — reconnect to edit this chat.

sync.pushSkills: Push this computer’s user skills to the server
sync.fileDone: File copied to the local cache.
sync.pdfDone: PDF copied to the local cache.
sync.experimentDone: Copied {{count}} experiment files to this computer.
sync.skillsDone: Pushed {{count}} skill files to the server.

modeSet.online-only: Remote sync is online only. Session copies will not update automatically.
